Dialogue_1a:
Tagelfar Garage.
The outside is cold, but garage gives you warm comfort for a little chit-chat.
Ravnos starts first.
Dialogue_2: What was that about your sister, Caitiff?
Dialogue_3: You must be mistaken, Ravnos. I said no such thing.
Dialogue_4a: Such a personal question. Are we friends now?
Dialogue_5: Job that requires asking for my sister? Huh.
Dialogue_5a: It's inconsequential to our current task. Focus.
Dialogue_7: Don't flatter yourself. There is job that needs to be done.
Dialogue_8: Why are you so afraid? Smells like a family issue to me...
Dialogue_10:
And that's how the story goes...
Then, suddenly they both notice something in the garage.
The same sign.
The same font.
The same paint.
Deja vu.
Everything is connected.
Dialogue_11: Be mindful where you step, Ravnos. One false move and our cover is blown. You know very well we can't afford that.
Dialogue_12: You worry too much. We're fine. I sneak around all the time.
Dialogue_13: Besides, what do you think they will do to us? They can't break masquerade.
Dialogue_14: The Anarchs are not to be trifled with.
Dialogue_15: Trust me, I had worse encounters than The Anarchs.
Dialogue_16: Please promise me that you will be careful.
Dialogue_Narrator: >>Zza okna słychać rytmiczne uderzanie kropel deszczu uderzających o parapet, przeplatające się z dźwiękiem samochodów przejeżdzających przez kałużę. Światło powoli przygasa, a z głośników sączy się leniwie>> >>>>Barry >>White>>
